name: rival
description: A quiet second reviewer: after a turn that changed files, a read-only subagent looks for correctness bugs in the diff and reports in a band above the prompt

enabled.title: Review after turns
enabled.description: After a turn that changed files, review the diff with a read-only subagent. Each review spends tokens (see the README).

model.title: Reviewer model
model.description: Model alias or id the reviewer runs on.

minLines.title: Smallest diff
minLines.description: Skip diffs with fewer changed lines than this.

minConfidence.title: Lowest confidence shown
minConfidence.description: Drop findings the reviewer rates below this (0 to 100).

cooldownMinutes.title: Cooldown
cooldownMinutes.description: Minutes between reviews; changes made meanwhile are reviewed by the next one. 0 reviews every changed turn.
